findings: Initial issued loss 15 includes the paid acquisition asset 10. Timely treaty recovery 7.5 is not reimbursement of half an acquisition invoice.
Both treaty-timing paths finish with cash and equity 35, despite different initial and service-period results.

The actual report preserves its blank onerous CSM and signed amounts. Displayed arithmetic discrepancies are addressed with explicitly hypothetical rounding witnesses, not invented reported precision. No new defect observed.
